    Questions & answers

    How do I place an order?

    Choose your services in the Pricing section, add your name, then tap Order on WhatsApp. It opens a ready message with your items and total, and you just send it to me.

    How long will my project take?

    It depends on the size of the project, and I confirm the time before I start. Fast delivery in 24–48 hours is available for +30%.

    How many revisions do I get?

    Every order includes 2 free revisions. You can choose 4 revisions (+10%) or unlimited revisions (+25%) before you order.

    How do I pay?

    Pay by Easypaisa or NayaPay, then send the payment screenshot on WhatsApp so I can confirm your order.

    What files will I receive?

    You get the final files ready to use, for example PNG or JPG for social posts, PDF for print and MP4 for videos. Tell me if you need a different format.

    What does the WhatsApp AI Agent do?

    It can automatically answer common customer questions, share your business information, collect leads and order details, and hand a conversation over to you when personal support is needed. The exact features depend on the setup and connected platforms.

    Can you make something that is not on the price list?

    Yes. Message me on WhatsApp with your idea, deadline and budget, and I will send you a quote.

    Let’s work together

    I’m open to new projects. Send me your idea, deadline and budget, and I’ll reply with a plan.
